description: Subscription windows and session cost of the coding agents installed on this machine, from their official sources only.

agentData.reason: Usage history: time, model and token counts of each reply (never the conversation).

zh-CN.reason: 用量历史：只读每次回复的时间、模型和 token 数，不读对话内容。

agentData.reason: Usage history: time, model and token counts of each turn (never the conversation).

zh-CN.reason: 用量历史：只读每轮的时间、模型和 token 数，不读对话内容。

octopus.agent-usage.claude.source.label: Claude usage source
octopus.agent-usage.claude.source.description: The status line is Claude Code's own report: from sessions started in Octopus, and from every session of the configurations connected above. A custom command can query anything you choose (a gateway, a script) and print JSON.

zh-CN.label: Claude 用量来源
zh-CN.description: 状态行是 Claude Code 自己的报告：来自 Octopus 启动的会话，以及上面“接入”过的配置里的所有会话。自定义命令可以查询你选的任何来源（网关、脚本），输出 JSON。

octopus.agent-usage.claude.command.label: Claude usage command
octopus.agent-usage.claude.command.description: Prints JSON: Claude's status line shape ({"rate_limits": {"five_hour": {"used_percentage": 64, "resets_at": 1762952400}}}) or {"windows": [{"label": "5h", "usedPercent": 64, "resetsAt": 1762952400}], "plan": "Max"}.

zh-CN.label: Claude 用量查询命令
zh-CN.description: 输出 JSON：Claude 状态行的格式（{"rate_limits": {"five_hour": {"used_percentage": 64, "resets_at": 1762952400}}}），或 {"windows": [{"label": "5 小时", "usedPercent": 64, "resetsAt": 1762952400}], "plan": "Max"}。

zh-CN.name: 智能体用量
zh-CN.description: 本机已安装的编程智能体的订阅窗口与会话成本，只用官方来源。
